implementation: Original bounded Python decoders and PDA derivation; no downloaded SDK or executable dependency

facts.reserved_fee_handling: Retained protocol/creator fees are already reflected negatively in virtual_quote_reserves; never subtract them twice from effective liquidity
facts.canonical_pool_creator: Pump PDA from pool-authority and base_mint; pool index is zero for migrated pools
facts.old_accounts: Missing whole appended fields default to zero, false or default pubkey
facts.transfer_fee_epoch: Select newer_transfer_fee when current epoch >= newer_transfer_fee.epoch, otherwise older_transfer_fee
facts.pool_allocation: Current Pool serialization is 287 bytes; documented extend_account allocation is 300 bytes. Accept exactly 300 only when the remaining 13 bytes are zero
facts.global_config_allocations: Current GlobalConfig is 949 bytes; documented previous versions are 907 and 940 bytes, each ending on a field boundary
facts.fee_config_allocation_versions: 2512=primary tiers only; 4073=primary plus stable tiers; 4097=plus exotic flat fees. Length gates determine field presence, not remaining dynamic-vector bytes
facts.fee_config_unused_tail: Official versioned reader ignores unused allocation bytes, which may hold stale nonzero bytes from shrunken vectors. Ignore that tail only for these exact documented allocation sizes

decoder_limits.quote_chain_curve: Depth and appended fields decoded; multi-hop execution not implemented by account decoder
decoder_limits.program_trust: Decoding does not authenticate deployed program code or RPC truth; runtime must verify target, owner, slots, vault and mint bindings
